svg.text: Reason tags on native rows (chronological order unchanged) and “Why is this here?” popover
Request addressed to team platform-reviewers, not to you
Another team member approved the latest commit
Data read from the PR 3 minutes ago: may be stale
Rule: team request + review by another member → Waiting.
Limit: “already satisfied” does not prove the branch policy is met.
Available tags (color + text + icon; each has an aria-label with the explanation)
“Team review request” does not imply the review is owed by you. “Re-review requested” appears only if GitHub exposes it.
• Tab moves focus to the tag; Enter or “?” opens the popover, Esc closes it.
• Light/dark theme: colors keep their contrast, text is never color alone.
• Narrow viewport: the tag wraps below the repository.
Reason changed in the same thread
Before: “Mention”. Now: “Direct review request”. Tag and popover
update without reloading; the row is highlighted for 3 seconds.
Module disabled: the page is identical to the native one (no tag, no popover, no added element).
Without PR access the tag shows only the native reason or “Unverifiable”. Mockup with entirely fictional data.
